response.sql: WITH op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gpm FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(gpm) AS a FROM op WHERE gpm IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(op.n * 1.0) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(op.gpm) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.gpm - ov.a) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM op CROSS JOIN ov WHERE op.gpm > ov.a
